"Burnham Set to Name Mahmood as UK Chancellor, Reports Say" — 15 July 2026.

Andy Burnham is set to appoint Shabana Mahmood as his Chancellor of the Exchequer, snubbing key ally and early favourite Ed Miliband for the role.

Burnham has picked Mahmood, who currently serves as Home Secretary, to lead the UK Treasury, the FT reported on Wednesday, citing three people briefed on the decision, one of whom described it to the paper as "nailed down."

People close to the incoming prime minister's thinking have said Miliband is likely to be moved instead to foreign secretary, while Mahmood, who sits on the right of the Labour Party, takes the UK's second most powerful office despite having no economics brief anywhere on her ministerial record.

STATUS: REPORTED / UNCONFIRMED until Monday's announcement.
